title: IMFuse: Instance-Aware Multi-Layer Fusion for LLM-Enhanced Sequential Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2607.27002v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Leveraging large language models (LLMs) to enrich item embeddings with textual semantics has become a prevailing paradigm for enhancing sequential recommendation (SR). However, existing methods typically rely solely on the final-layer LLM embeddings, leaving the semantics encoded in other layers largely unexploited. Through an empirical analysis, we uncover three key findings: 1) item embeddings from deeper LLM layers suffer from increasingly severe spectral collapse, which reduces their information richness and hinders the optimization; 2) intermediate LLM layers encode complementary item semantics beyond the final layer; 3) different items exhibit heterogeneous layer-wise semantic patterns. translated_title: IMFuse：面向LLM增强序列推荐的实例感知多层融合
translated_abstract: 利用大型语言模型（LLM）以文本语义丰富物品嵌入，已成为增强序列推荐（SR）的主流范式。然而，现有方法通常仅依赖LLM的最后一层嵌入，其他层中编码的语义在很大程度上未被利用。通过实证分析，我们发现了三个关键结论：1）来自LLM更深层的物品嵌入会出现日益严重的谱坍缩（spectral collapse），这降低了其信息丰富度并阻碍了优化过程；2）LLM的中间层编码了超出最后一层的互补性物品语义；3）不同物品呈现出异构的层级语义模式。这些发现表明，仅使用最后一层是不够的，应当为每个物品自适应地利用多层的LLM语义。为此，我们提出了IMFuse，一种新颖的实例感知多层融合策略，用于LLM增强的序列推荐。
tldr: 提出IMFuse实例感知多层融合策略，自适应地为每个物品融合LLM多个层的嵌入语义，克服了仅依赖最后一层嵌入存在谱坍缩、信息不足的问题，从而增强序列推荐性能。
